body:
At approximately 9 pm, on that boring Friday night I picked up some hash from a buddy of mine. He explained everything from what the effects are and how to use a pipe. I was curious and bored, seeing all I did up until that point was smoke a few cigarettes and drink booze.
12:20am - I'm alone in my room, on my computer, listening to some music and watching some funny videos. Still sober. In front of me is a pipe I borrowed from my friend, a glass one, kind of cool looking actually. Right next to it is hash mixed with some tobacco. I'm a little excited actually, I'm going to smoke soon.
12:30am - Alright, it's right in front of me and I can't stand just looking at it! Going to smoke.
12:33am - Just took the first hit, it was pretty harsh and took me a long time. Felt like my lungs were burning, felt like throwing up and my throat is burning. Don't feel anything yet. I'm gonna take another hit.
12:35 - Took the second hit, and I'm really dizzy, kind of like when I smoke a cigarette really fast without breathing air. Another hit or two?
12:41- Okay, I don't know if the effects are starting but somethings definitely weird and my heart is fuckin racing. Really racing! Jesus, yes I think the effects yes. 4 hits total, I reckon I'm  gonna put some music hehehehe.
12:50- Fuck I feel like everything is spinning like a carousel but I'm watching it in slowmo but I'm in regular-mo. I'm normal but the rests spinning like spiders.
I don't know the time hahahaaha - that's so funny. I wish I  smoked this with somebody. It'd be so much fun to share stories together. I think that I'm pretty high. 4 hits, yes I am. My entire lower body is completely numb and I think I'm gonna listen to some pink floyd. I just put on dark side. Seems timeless. I think that the time is slower than it really is. Maybe if I twist it'd get faster. Want to go out but there's no fuckin way I'm driving like this. Gonna watch a movie.
Seems timeless. I think that the time is slower than it really is. Maybe if I twist it'd get faster. Want to go out but there's no fuckin way I'm driving like this. Gonna watch a movie.
02:08 - Most of the effects pretty much wore off. I still feel a little high, more of a body high, a little tingly and heavy. Feels really good though. My brain is completely sober though. I got bored with the movie (The Matrix, the only movie I had on my computer) but it seemed really fascinating when I was high. It was amazing. Gonna grab something to eat.
2:25- Jesus christ I just ate the whole fuckin house. I never ate so much and I'm still hungry. But I'm tired and I think I'm gonna go to sleep.
OK I just woke up, had a good night's sleep.  There's one word that can sum up this experience - Awesome! There were a few bad things like my heartbeat got really fast, and the mouth got dry, but I really enjoyed it.
